item.title: PAPERHEAD
item.description:
Title: PAPERHEAD
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Paperhead te4m
Publisher: HypeTrain Digital
Release Date: Oct 9, 2026




About This Game

PAPERHEAD is a mix of a fast-paced movement boomer shooter and an adventure horror game , featuring a unique soundtrack .

In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong.
Explore the abandoned research facility and uncover the dark truth of
... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

BRUTAL AND SWIFT COMBAT

  • Toss enemies into the air, kick exploding barrels at them, and jump on their heads like an Italian plumber!
  • Or simply blast them to smithereens with a shotgun!

DRAW YOUR WAY OUT OF [REDACTED]

The pencil - is not only your weapon but a tool to change the world around you.
  • Sketch bombs to kick them at your enemies!
  • Draw doors to kick down!
  • Write ██████ words on walls – no reason needed!

CUTE... BUT SCARY

A charming and cute cardboard world... with more meat than expected. Even paper can instill fear!

PAPER CAN BE TOUGHER THAN METAL

An industrial soundtrack that will pump high-octane cardboard through your veins.

Go ahead and find out...
WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?



P.S. And please don’t cut your fingers in the process! :-)

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Cartoonish blood & gore.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later
    • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce 9800GT Or Equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 9.0
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Any
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: 2.4 GHZ Quad Core Processor Or Higher
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Geforce GTX 460 Or Equivalent
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Any

item.title: Truckful
item.description:
Title: Truckful
Genre: Action , Adventure
Developer: MythicOwl
Publisher: MythicOwl , Pocketpair Publishing
Release Date: Oct 9, 2026




About This Game

Truckful is a single player car delivery adventure game based around completing errands and quests for villagers and uncovering the ancient mystery that surrounds the nearby old forest.

Drive your pickup truck through winding countryside roads, dusty lowlands and small towns. Upgrade the truck, improve its weight and load capacity to make it go faster through all kinds of demanding routes. Pack the bed with fragile & shaky cargo of all shapes and kinds, whether its ice cold fish that needs to be delivered fast, or a classic grandma vase that will put your driving skills to the true test.

The seemingly welcoming countryside has its secrets. Hidden paths, misty wetlands, unforgiving marshes and dusty quicksands tell the stories of the past, waiting to be discovered. Explore a variety of landmarks and its surroundings and discover secrets hidden behind the forest branches.

Your quest requires a trustworthy tool to get you through some of the most challenging errands swiftly - an old reliable pickup truck. With a large cargo bed, it can deliver all kinds of goods to the townsfolk that will appreciate your work and often help with upgrades, scrap collection and more. They will also help you unveil the great forest mystery.

The ancient forest on the countryside outskirts is unwelcoming to visitors and often mentioned in local legends and myths. The overwhelming feeling of something lurking in the tree branch shadows is hard to shake off. Face the adversity and uncover its deep roots.

GAME FEATURES

  • Drive, upgrade and customize your pickup truck

  • Pack the truck bed with cargo of all shapes and sizes

  • Complete errands for villagers in need

  • Enjoy a physics-based car handling gameplay

  • Unravel the mystery of the old forest

item.title: Asobi: Remote Play
item.description:
Title: Asobi: Remote Play
Genre: Free To Play , Utilities
Developer: Inside Internet
Publisher: Inside Internet
Release Date: Oct 9, 2026




About This Software

Turn your Windows, Linux or Steam device into a high-quality remote streaming client for your own PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 console.

Designed for players who want a flexible way to stream from their own console, this app supports physical controllers, adaptive video quality, and advanced display options.

Core experience:

• Connect to your own PS4® or PS5® console for remote streaming
• Sync app settings and console profiles across your devices
• Multiple local profiles for different users or setups
• 1080p / 30 fps SDR Remote Play streaming
• Automatic bitrate adjustment based on your network
• Internet remote streaming support
• Automatic and Manual console registration flow for supported consoles
• Easy PSN sign in
• Support for up to 4 player Multiplayer PS4 and PS5 Remote Play
• Support for up to 4 player Multiplayer PS3, PS4 and PS5 Cloud Streaming
• 720p / 50 fps SDR Cloud streaming
• Optional PS3, PS4 and PS5 cloud-streaming compatibility where available ("PlayStation Plus Premium subscription required for cloud streaming")
• Support for Windows, Linux and SteamOS

Unlock the full experience with Asobi Premium with features such as,

• Full controller support such as haptics and gyro
• Full 1:1 adaptive trigger support when using a DualSense controller
• Low-latency modes
• Manual bitrate control
• Up to 1080p / 60 fps / HDR Remote Play streaming
• Up to 4K native / 60 fps / HDR PS Cloud streaming
• Up to 4K upscaling on supported displays
• Up to 120 fps output via "linear" or "flow" frame generation on supported monitors
• Realtime 2D to 3D conversion with four modes: Full SBS, Half SBS Red/Cyan and Magenta/Green
• 16 screen filters, including Vivid, Monochrome, Cell Shaded and 32-bit modes, to add more variety to your gameplay
• Audio delay and behaviour settings
• Zoom & Pan for a full-screen experience
• Ambient light spill mode
• On-screen lightbar-style status indicator
• On-device gyro input support
• On-device haptic feedback

item.title: Permafrost
item.description:
Title: Permafrost
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: SpaceRocket Games
Publisher: Toplitz Productions
Release Date: Oct 9, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 9, 2026




About This Game

You are a “Rook”; an engineer with the skills to rebuild, but little wilderness experience, drawn into this frozen, unforgiving world by a radio signal from a long-lost friend.

Experience a grounded, story-driven open-world survival set in a near-future Earth locked in endless winter after a series of catastrophes that culminated in the shattering of the moon. As a solo player or together with up to 3 friends, explore frozen cities and wilderness, survive brutal weather, navigate faction-controlled territories, hunt, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to endure this post-apocalyptic world.

THE COLD IS YOUR TRUE ENEMY!

The cold is alive and ever-present. Frostbite, storms, and creeping chill shape every journey, turning preparation, shelter, and timing into matters of survival.

A FROZEN OPEN WORLD TO EXPLORE!

Traverse a frozen open world where city ruins fade into wilderness. A tense, grounded survival experience shaped by silence and scarcity - no constant gunfire, no fantasy tropes. Just winter, isolation, and resolve.

EXPLORATION-GATED PROGRESSION!

Progress is earned through exploration and adaptation. Restore abandoned shelters, repair broken machines, and reclaim fragile technology to push deeper into the frozen world.

YOUR DOG AS YOUR LOYAL COMPANION!

Your loyal dog companion stands with you when the cold turns everything else silent. Rescued from the ruins, your dog scouts ahead, warns of danger, carries supplies, and keeps you grounded when the silence gets to be too much.

SYMBIOTIC 1-4 PLAYER CO-OP SURVIVAL!

The cold doesn't care how many of you there are. Play solo or survive alongside up to 3 friends, building shelter networks, dividing responsibilities, and playing to each other's strengths. Co-op doesn't simplify the world; it just means you don't face the cold alone.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game contains depictions of violence against humans and animals, as well as the use of tobacco, alcohol, and unspecified medicine to endure harsh cold conditions.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3500
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 590 8GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 30 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (x64)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 Ti 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT 12GB
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 30 GB available space

item.title: Used Cars Simulator
item.description:
Title: Used Cars Simulator
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , Racing , Simulation
Developer: DreamWay Games
Publisher: PlayWay S.A.
Release Date: Oct 9, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Apr 9, 2025




About This Game

Welcome to the world of trading used (or stolen) cars!

Got little money and nothing to lose? We were waiting for you!

In Used Cars Simulator , you’ll fix up cars, put them up for sale, grow your business in an old shed, drive around an abandoned city, drink beer, and wander the desert with a metal detector.

And it all starts when you meet a beautiful woman in a red dress at your favorite bar… Are you in?

FIND A GOOD OFFER

In Used Cars Simulator , you'll learn how to make money by trading cars.

First, find a good deal. Check the car’s condition, negotiate the price, and if everything looks good - just buy it.

FIX THE CAR

Fix the dents, order and install missing parts, wash the car, repaint it, and put it up for sale. If it wasn’t yours, you’d probably want to buy it yourself!

BE BAD

In Used Cars Simulator, there are many ways to get cars. Are they all legal? Sure - as long as the cops don’t catch you.

HAVE FUN

After work, have some fun - drift, jump, and compare your scores with other players on the leaderboards.

PROGRESS

What’s coming in future updates? You tell us! Let us know which features we should add.

Key Features of Used Cars Simulator:

✅ Car Trading & Flipping

✅ Story & Quests

✅ Physics & Sandbox

✅ Illegal Activities

✅ Police Interactions

✅ World Exploration

✅ Upgrades & Economy

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Win10 64bit
    • Processor: i3-4130 @ 3.3GHz / AMD FX-8350

    • Graphics: GTX1050ti / R9 280
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: System Requirements subject to change as development continues
    Recommended:
    • OS: Win10 64bit
    • Processor: i7-9700 @ 3.6 GHz or Ryzen 5 3600 @ 3.6 GHz
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
    • Storage: 24 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: System Requirements subject to change as development continues
